interest: Shows 1946-47 Washington-SCAP tension over Japan's food relief amid a global grain shortage and farm-quota pressure.
overview: File (1946-47) on Japan's food crisis: Cabinet debate on MacArthur's 500,000-ton grain request amid global shortage, a mission to press grain collections, domestic US conservation measures, and a 1947 SCAP study on Japan's summer grain-collection program.
